# `⍋` — Grade up

`⍋Y` gives indices that sort major cells ascending. Stable; uses [structural ordering](../rules.qmd#equality-and-ordering), without tolerance.

```apl
⍋30 10 20          ⍝ 1ₓ 2ₓ 0ₓ
v←30 10 20 ⋄ v ⍋v  ⍝ 10 20 30
⍋2 1 2 1           ⍝ 1ₓ 3ₓ 0ₓ 2ₓ
```

`C⍋Y` uses a character collation array `C`.

```apl
"cba"⍋"abc"        ⍝ 2ₓ 1ₓ 0ₓ
```

See [`⍒`](grade-down.qmd).
